newsitem.title: USA: Stryker U.S. sales up 22 pct in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Stryker U.S. sales up 22 pct in Q3.

text.p: Stryker Corp said Monday its domestic sales grew 22 percent in the third quarter while international sales declined eight percent.

Stryker said domestic sales rose on strong shipments of orthopaedic implants, endoscopic equipment and powered surgical instruments, as well as increased revenue from physical therapy services and higher shipments of hospital beds and stretchers.
International sales declined as lower sales in Japan offset strong shipments in other markets. Sales in Japan declined 26 percent in the third quarter.
Unfavorable currency comparisons, principally against the Japanese yen, reduced the dollar value of international sales by $6.9 million for the third quarter, Stryker added.
Earlier, Stryker reported third quarter earnings of $0.25 a share, up from $0.21 a year ago.
